title: C05: authenticate same-build generated GCC data and record guarded directives
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Supplies actual generated GCC plugin-header/configuration data tied to the exact installed GCC build by matching SHA256/size rows in retained changes and buildinfo, plus bounded ar/control/directive parsers. The view records21 ordered tm.h includes,11 guarded distro defaults,five configure-default entries and a38-member/38-edge literal graph.

This is an individually completed prerequisite component in the original C05/full named V03 assignment. **Complete C05, complete V03, effective configuration, original execution and runtime qualification remain open.** No performance or κ gain is claimed.

## Task and overlap

Task-card scope is changed to this concrete code increment; the user-assigned original C05/full V03 completion criteria are unchanged. Base `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`; published head `97dd394ce1ddf00cc80dfdaad71767fdbc85af47`; tree `8ccf73c9a29e66c0f91d3ef535f57abb19600d61` matches byte-checked local commit `4a1577e41acf254bef52bfadbfcffca42bc9159d`. 535 new files, one commit.

Canonical investigation #6321. #6362 (`120072d58ddb46f0e02886756243174d41fce42e`) provides the earlier partial input-edge/source/data helpers. #6363 (`a8cf650b7435ccea237084e491e339f725c0a35b`) provides exact parent/domain compatibility findings and the bounded related-PR graph. This adds the reviewed implementation and cold inputs for its named scope; it does not replace the original activity with a finite test.

```sh
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/h25-gcc-generated-config-data

```

29 new pure controls passed in normal Python and -O. Independent Sol Max source/delta review accepted the bounded recorder after fixing archive-offset variable clobber and forged embedded-report provenance; cross-export and documentation-delta review passed. The packet contains all472 pinned headers, the exact1,451,870-byte raw package, build/embedded/compiler-member reports, preserved rejected sources, and licenses.

Registered replay uses only new code and committed inert source/data inputs. No original module, Root/provider/parent, compiler/native target, namespace or scientific workload runs. Actual hosted checks will be recorded after submission, bound to this exact head.

The recorder preserves conditions without evaluating them. One angle-include edge, cpplib.h, remains unresolved rather than classified absent.
